summary: Great Elm Capital Corp. filed an 8-K to report a sixth amendment to its existing credit facility with City National Bank. The amendment extends the revolving facility maturity date to the earlier of June 8, 2029 or March 31, 2029 if its 8.50% notes due 2029 are not refinanced. No sale, acquisition, or shareholder event is involved. This is a routine bank-debt modification with no equity impact, deal premium, or board recommendation. The filing merely updates lender terms, thus not a special situation.
